value_or_angle: header="She drew holiday stamps for the Post Office" body="Before printmaking, Julia illustrated for newspapers, magazines and advertising agencies, among them holiday stamps for the U.S. Postal Service. Scolded for doodling in school, she still fills a sketchbook about every six months." category=arts

header="Her students print with a steamroller" body="Julia teaches a class in carving large relief prints at the Mosesian Center for the Arts in Watertown. It ends at the town's community arts fair, where she and her students print their linoleum blocks under a steamroller." category=arts

header="Escher, she says, was the gateway drug" body="Julia paints on linoleum before she carves it with Japanese tools; On the Night You Were Born, made at a California residency, prints from three 24-inch panels. She says M. C. Escher was her gateway drug to art." category=arts
